This novel masterfully intertwines romance, high-stakes drama, and the relentless pursuit of truth. If you are looking for a deeply nuanced courtroom mystery, this story is designed to keep you guessing until the very last page.

Opposing them is Kate, the sharp prosecutor. An experienced professional, Kate knows that in the courtroom, only one thing matters: facts. She is convinced of James's guilt and is determined to make him pay, no matter the cost.

But as the legal battle intensifies, the lines between right and wrong blur. Who truly has the right to judge James? Is it Sophie, driven by instinct; or is it Kate, wielding professional experience? *Anatomia unui scandal* asks these profound questions: who holds the truth, and can justice prevail when reputations hang in the balance?
